an3.45:1.1: “Bhikkhus, there are these three things prescribed by the wise, prescribed by good people.
an3.45:1.3: (1) Giving is prescribed by the wise, prescribed by good people.
an3.45:1.4: (2) The going forth is prescribed by the wise, prescribed by good people.
an3.45:1.5: (3) Attending upon one’s mother and father is prescribed by the wise, prescribed by good people.
an3.45:1.6: These three things are prescribed by the wise, prescribed by good people.”
an3.45:2.3: service to one’s mother and father
an3.45:2.4: and to the peaceful followers of the spiritual life.
an3.45:3.1: These are the deeds of the good
an3.45:3.2: which the wise person should pursue.
an3.45:3.3: The noble one possessed of vision
